title: Open the new alert rule page

blocks.content:
A clear, descriptive name is the first thing responders see when an alert fires. A good name tells them immediately what's wrong without opening the alert details.

In this milestone, you'll open the new alert rule page and give your rule a name.

blocks.title: Open the new alert rule page

blocks.content: Open the **Alert rules** page. In the main menu, you'll find it under **Alerting > Alert rules**.
Click **+ New alert rule** to open the new alert rule page.
You're now on the new alert rule page.

Enter a descriptive name for your alert rule that tells responders triage alerts quickly, especially when multiple alerts fire at once. In the **Alert rule name** field, `QuickPizza server errors` is filled in for you.
blocks.tooltip: Responders see this name first when the alert fires.

blocks.content: In the next milestone, you learn how to build the query that defines what your alert monitors.
